method: Whole-file manual reading of UiWindow.h in three complete ranges; pinned bytes verified. No Windows execution.
findings: Attach refuses null/already-owned handles and stores object property and owner thread. Native subclass creation installs framework procedure and rolls back properties/procedure on failure; ordinary window creation uses thread-local creation scope.

Destructor distinguishes subclassed native controls from framework-owned windows, attempts procedure restoration and detaches or destroys accordingly. It does not enforce calling owner thread; Windows thread/lifetime contracts still apply.

Dispatch catches handler exceptions, validates paint region on paint exception, returns-1for create failure and otherwise0, then detaches and clears super procedure on nonclient destruction. Silent exception containment does not establish successful operation.
SendNativeMessage bypasses framework on owner thread through previous procedure, but uses synchronous SendMessage across threads. No timeout or deadlock prevention provided here.

Typed route thunks statically reject unsupported member signatures and decode mouse coordinates as signed16bit; size fields use unsigned LOWORD/HIWORD. Notification parameters rely on message contract; arbitrary pointer input not validated.

Route result is optional: contained0still means handled. Derived route tables are checked before base; reflected control/notification handling precedes parent handling. Command probing execute=false detects matching route without running it.

Menu/accelerator commands with no control HWND consult UpdateCode enabled state before execution; control notifications do not use that gate. This UI enabled-state mechanism is not a replacement for handler preconditions.

Owner-draw dispatch publishes scoped thread-local row geometry, permitting cached rectangle methods without recursive native queries. Device-context wrappers pair GetDC/ReleaseDC and BeginPaint/EndPaint; general resource failure tests not executed.
limits: No native creation/subclass rollback, HWND reuse, cross-thread messaging, route ABI, paint exception or teardown runtime tests performed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
